texts.heroHeadline: Your Independent Eyes and Ears on the Ground in Egypt.
texts.heroSubheadline: Gama-CS operates as an uncompromising direct extension of European, U.S., and international quality assurance directors.
texts.pledgeSubtitle: 100% retained & paid exclusively by international buyers. We take $0 from Egyptian suppliers and factories to guarantee uncompromised integrity.
texts.pledgePoint1: 100% Retained & Paid Exclusively by the International Buyer
texts.pledgePoint2: Zero Supplier Kickbacks, Advisory, or Certifications Sold to Factories
texts.pledgePoint3: Immediate Blacklisting of Any Compromised Facility or Misreported Batch
texts.edgeBadge: Strategic Edge: Why Egypt & Why Gama-CS
texts.edgeTitle: Local Fluency, Geopolitical Resilience & Packing Corridor Mastery
texts.edgeSubtitle: Why sourcing from Egypt with local independent oversight is critical for European, U.S., and international buyers.
texts.edgeFluencyDesc: Uncompromised vernacular fluency and deep local industrial corridor mastery (Sadat City, 6th of October, 10th of Ramadan, Borg El Arab).
texts.edgeFlightTitle: EU & US Flight Restrictions & Regional Mobility
texts.edgeFlightDesc: Middle East airspace reroutes and travel advisories frequently prevent foreign expat inspectors from flying in. Our senior Egyptian resident engineers deploy same-day.
texts.edgeHarvestDesc: Egypt provides extended harvest windows for fresh produce and IQF vegetables. We maintain year-round vigilance during critical export transitions.
texts.edgeMindsetDesc: Knowing how Egyptian packing plants operate from the inside out and expertly mitigating business, chemical MRL, and quality risks before departure.
texts.servicesSubtitle: Practical on-site quality oversight engineered for international buyers.
texts.service1Desc: Station-by-station IQF & produce sorting supervision, continuous core temp logging, optical sorter efficiency, and CCP validation.
texts.service2Title: Claim Investigations & Forensic Root Cause Analysis
texts.service2Desc: Independent origin verification for commercial disputes, off-spec arrivals, pesticide MRL exceedances, or unapproved batch blending.
texts.service3Desc: Dedicated technical representation on Egyptian ground without local corporate registration, HR liabilities, or foreign currency exposure.
texts.service4Desc: Pre-cooling validation, continuous pulp temperature checks, pallet securing, and high-security tamper-evident container bolt seal witnessing.
texts.modelTitle: How We Operate Under Your Command
texts.modelSubtitle: A structured 4-step deployment cycle designed to give international buyers full transparency from intake to container dispatch.
texts.modelStep1Desc: Buyer transmits product specifications, AQL thresholds, and specific unannounced audit parameters.
texts.modelStep2Desc: Senior QA auditors mobilize to the designated packhouse or cold storage without advance warning to factory management.
texts.modelStep3Desc: Within 4 hours of line inspection, an encrypted flash summary with brix, defect tallies, and photos is dispatched.
texts.modelStep4Desc: Final sign-off certificate, sealed bolt verification, and final loading authorization delivered to your private database.
texts.databaseSubtitle: Every client receives a strictly isolated, encrypted database. No supplier, competitor, or third party can ever view your evaluations or scorecards.
texts.sectorsSubtitle: Comprehensive coverage across Sadat City, Alexandria, 6th of October, 10th of Ramadan, and Upper Egypt agricultural basins.
texts.contactTitle: Commission a Quality Directive in Egypt
texts.footerDescription: Gama Corporate Solutions (Gama-CS) provides dedicated quality governance, shop-floor audit execution, and technical dispute resolution across Egypt exclusively for European and international buyers.
